name: The Last Prayer
storyline:
The Last Prayer is a first-person psychological horror game inspired by real events. In the game, you play as a man of faith who has served for many years. One night, you receive a desperate call regarding a young man living in an isolated old house, where terrifying and unexplainable events began after he experimented with forbidden rituals and black magic.

As you arrive at the house, you are confronted with abandoned hallways, a distorted sense of reality, and the presence of a dark entity lurking within. The deeper you investigate, the more you uncover about the young man’s obsession with different religions and forbidden texts, which ultimately led him to unknowingly summon something dangerous.

While trying to save a possessed soul, the player must also confront their own fears and faith. With its realistic home environment, psychological tension, and constantly escalating paranormal events, the game slowly blurs the line between reality and nightmare.
summary:
The Last Prayer is a first-person psychological horror game.
How much can a game truly affect your real life?

Set within a realistic home environment and inspired by real events, this story places you in the middle of terrifying moments beyond imagination. As you confront the darkness lurking within, the line between reality and nightmare slowly begins to fade.
